Build a 52-node n8n workflow
Claude computer use built a 52-node n8n workflow in one afternoon that would normally take three weekends.
Done with
CU
Claude computer use
N8
n8n
What they did
The user tasked Claude Computer Use with building a 52-node n8n workflow. The agent performed the full build on its own in one afternoon.
How it went
The workflow was completed in one afternoon rather than the three weekends required previously. It breaks on every API update.
Worth knowing
The workflow breaks every time the API updates.
Try it yourself
with
Claude computer use
Copy prompt
Open my n8n instance at [URL] and build a workflow that does this: [describe trigger, steps, and apps involved, e.g. new form response, enrich in a spreadsheet, send a Slack summary]. Add and connect the nodes, name each one clearly, and run a test with sample data. You're done when the test run succeeds end to end and you've given me a list of every node and any credentials I still need to connect. Don't activate the workflow or send real messages until I confirm.
